text: In every society of men, in every club I ever yet saw, you find some who are timid, their fears hurry them away upon every alarm; some who are selfish and avaricious, on whose callous hearts nothing but interest and money can make impression.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 50, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 7 July, 1775
